_om: Stigespillet in English (The Ladder Game, rusj.no/en/ladder-game/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Først til rute 100 vinner! Stigene tar d: First to square 100 wins! Ladders take you up, slides take you down.
Trykk på den store «Kast»-knappen. Brikk: Tap the big ‘Roll’ button. Your counter hops as many squares as the dice shows.
Lander du nederst på en stige, klatrer d: Land at the foot of a ladder and you climb up. Land at the top of a slide and you whizz down.
Den som først kommer til rute 100 med po: The first to reach square 100, with the trophy, wins!
Alle starter på rute 1. Den som står før: Everyone starts on square 1. Whoever is top of the list goes first – why not put the youngest first?
Seks gir et ekstra kast. Det kan skrus a: A six gives an extra roll. You can switch that off when you get ready.
Vanlig er at du kommer i mål selv om du: Normally you finish even if you roll too high. Want it harder? Switch on ‘Exact roll to 100’.
Mobilen kan ta de ledige plassene – også: The phone can fill the empty seats – even when you play on your own.
On your own? Then you play against the phone.
Den øverste begynner – sett gjerne den y: The top one starts – why not put the youngest first?
Hvor mange plasser mobilen tar: How many seats the phone takes
Mobilen tar de ledige plassene – de hete: The phone takes the empty seats – they're called {navn}
Mobilen tar de ledige plassene – den het: The phone takes the empty seat – it's called {navn}
Mobilen tar de ledige plassene: The phone takes the empty seats
Seks gir et ekstra kast: A six gives an extra roll
Roll a six and you go again.
You need exactly the right number to finish.
Av: slår du for mye, kommer du i mål lik: Off: roll too high and you still finish.
Først til 100 – mobilen var heldig denne: First to 100 – the phone got lucky this time. Rematch?
Whoever has got furthest is crowned the winner.
